name: Photo Coach
mission: Learn to see — a quiet field guide beside you on the trail. Conditions, opportunities, composition, editing philosophy, and gear knowledge for your Sony a6700.
portfolioNote: Long-horizon photography growth instrument — not a dashboard, not social performance.
strategicRole: Photo Coach builds a 10+ year path toward gallery-quality outdoor photography: understanding why images work, reading light, and integrating photography into hiking and conservation.
learnToday: Today's photography conditions from live weather — golden hour, fog, clouds, wind
Field opportunities matched to current light and season
One composition concept at a time with simple diagrams
A pre-shutter checklist that slows you down before pressing the button
